objective: Confirmar en READ_ONLY_SQL si Q02-SOCIOID-AS-TEXT falla solo por serializacion de uniqueidentifier, convirtiendolo a varchar(36). No modificar nada ni avanzar a 12K.

queries.name: q02_socioid_as_text
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) AS SocioID_text FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios ORDER BY SocioID;
